title: Canonical Commerce Pipeline
acceptance: Single canonical quote API (`POST /checkout/quote`) and order creation API (`POST /checkout`)
Enforced state machine: PENDING_PAYMENT -> PLACED -> ACCEPTED -> PREPARING -> READY -> OUT_FOR_DELIVERY -> DELIVERED
Return state machine: RETURN_REQUESTED -> RETURN_APPROVED -> RETURNED -> REFUNDED
Terminal states: CANCELLED_BY_CUSTOMER, REJECTED_BY_SELLER, CANCELLED_BY_ADMIN, PAYMENT_FAILED, EXPIRED
Append-only status history table with role-based transition authorization
Legacy order creation routes safely proxy to canonical pipeline or return 410
tests: [P1.1] pipeline: canonical state transitions
[P1.2] pipeline: legacy order route proxies
